# pve_ceph_rules (Data Source)

The Ceph CRUSH rules of the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_ceph_rules" "example" {
node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/ceph/rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the CRUSH rule.
